name: learned_primary_candidate_v2_seed42_train_validation_only
command: import json, pathlib, torch; from src.phase3_data import load_splits,file_sha256; from src.phase3_experiments import train_model,predict,_metrics,_checkpoint_payload; s=load_splits(['train','validation']); m,meta=train_model('LearnedSinkhornMatcher',42,s['train'],s['validation']); d=pathlib.Path('results/phase3/model_selection'); d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); cp=d/'candidate_v2_seed42.pt'; torch.save(_checkpoint_payload(m,meta),cp); out={'candidate':'v2','seed':42,'checkpoint':str(cp),'checkpoint_sha256':file_sha256(cp),'train':_metrics(*predict(m,s['train'])),'validation':_metrics(*predict(m,s['validation'])),'metadata':meta}; (d/'candidate_v2_seed42.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8'); print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
